prompt: Write a one-star review of the Eiffel Tower from an American who has seen the one in Las Vegas.
response:
**"The Eiffel Tower in Paris is a Total Rip-Off Compared to Vegas!"** ⭐

Let me tell you something, folks—if you’ve seen the Eiffel Tower in Las Vegas, you’ve *already seen the best version*. The one in Paris? Overrated, overpriced, and way too crowded. First off, it’s *half the size* of the Vegas replica (okay, fine, maybe not *half*, but it *feels* smaller). And don’t even get me started on the view—Vegas has better lighting, better shows, and you can actually *get a drink* while you’re up there without paying $20 for a tiny bottle of water.

The lines? Absurd. In Vegas, you just walk right up, no waiting. Here? Two hours in the sun just to ride an elevator that smells like old cheese. And the "romantic" vibe? Please. Vegas has better romance—at least there, you can gamble away your sorrows *while* looking at the tower.

Save your money, skip Paris, and just go to Vegas. The Eiffel Tower there is *better* in every way—bigger, brighter, and way more fun. 1/5 stars. Would not recommend unless you enjoy disappointment.
